# MCP tool reference

The `odoo20` MCP server exposes 20 tools. In Claude Code their full names are
`mcp__plugin_odoo20_odoo20__<tool>` (for example `mcp__plugin_odoo20_odoo20__odoo_model`); in other MCP
clients they keep the short names below.

- **Static tools** read the source index built from your Odoo 20 tree and extra addons paths. They never
  touch a database and are marked read-only, so Claude Code can run them in parallel.
- **`resolve="db"`** on `odoo_model`, `odoo_views` and `odoo_assets` asks Odoo itself (an `odoo-bin` helper
  on an allowlisted database) for the exact final result: fields, combined view arch, bundle file list.
- **Runtime tools** run `odoo-bin` with the `odoo_python` interpreter, only on databases matching the
  `db_allow` option. Tools that can change something carry `destructiveHint`, so Claude Code asks before
  running them (unless you allow them in your permission settings). See [safety.md](safety.md).
- Most tools take `format="markdown"` (default) or `format="json"`, plus `limit`/`offset` for pagination.
  Output is capped at about 25,000 characters with a hint on how to narrow the query.

| Tool | Kind | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| [`odoo_status`](#odoo_status) | read-only | Odoo version, source/addons paths, index state, runtime interpreter, database allowlist, live config |
| [`odoo_search`](#odoo_search) | read-only | Find Odoo symbols by (fuzzy, substring) name across all indexed modules: modules, models, fields (model.field), methods (model.method()), XML ids, OWL templates, JS registry entries (category:key), JS modules (@addon/path), JS classes and asset bundles |
| [`odoo_grep`](#odoo_grep) | read-only | Full-text search over the Odoo source tree (framework + all addons) and extra addons paths, using git grep |
| [`odoo_module`](#odoo_module) | read-only | Module overview: manifest, depends, dependency/install closure, dependents, load order, files by type, models defined/extended, views, data records, asset bundles, tests, migrations/upgrades/populate dirs |
| [`odoo_model`](#odoo_model) | read-only | Merged view of an Odoo model across modules (static): every contributing class in load order, mixin parents, _inherits delegation, attributes (_order, _rec_name...), all fields with type/comodel/key attributes and which modules define or override them, methods and SQL constraints/indexes |
| [`odoo_method`](#odoo_method) | read-only | Override chain of a model method in call order (last-loaded override first, down to mixins and BaseModel): module, file:line, decorators, signature, and whether each override calls super() |
| [`odoo_xmlid`](#odoo_xmlid) | read-only | Where an XML id is defined (model, file:line, key values, noupdate) and every XML/CSV/Python reference to it (ref=, eval ref(), %(xmlid)d, inherit_id, groups, menu parent/action, env.ref, has_group) |
| [`odoo_views`](#odoo_views) | read-only | Backend views and server QWeb templates: inheritance tree (priority, mode, groups, xpath specs, file:line) for an xmlid, or the primary views of a model |
| [`odoo_access`](#odoo_access) | read-only | Odoo 20 access control for a model: every ir.access row (CSV and XML) split into permissions (with a group, OR-ed) and restrictions (no group, AND-ed), with operation, domain, module and location; plus field-level groups |
| [`odoo_js`](#odoo_js) | read-only | Odoo web client (OWL 3) lookups from static/src: registry entries, patch() targets, ES module exports and importers, OWL templates and their t-inherit extensions, component classes |
| [`odoo_assets`](#odoo_assets) | read-only | Asset bundle composition from all manifests in module load order: append/prepend/before/after/replace/ remove/include directives and globs |
| [`odoo_validate`](#odoo_validate) | read-only | Static validation for Odoo 20: legacy (&lt;=19) patterns that break in 20 with the fix and the upgrade_code script that automates it; Odoo's RNG schemas for data files and views; cross-module checks (view fields and buttons exist on the model, missing depends, ir.access rows, xmlids, JS imports, unloaded files); ruff |
| [`odoo_upgrade_code`](#odoo_upgrade_code) | asks first | Run Odoo's own upgrade_code scripts (odoo/upgrade_code) on a sandbox copy of your addon and return a unified diff: 19.x -&gt; 20.0 rewrites (t-call params, base64-&gt;bytes, ir.model.access+ir.rule -&gt; ir.access, ormcache, Material Symbols icons, search date filters) plus OWL 2 -&gt; 3 |
| [`odoo_scaffold`](#odoo_scaffold) | writes files | Create an Odoo 20 module skeleton that installs and passes its tests as generated: model with models.Constraint, security/ir.access.csv (permission + multi-company restriction), list/form/search views with &lt;chatter/&gt;, action with path, menus, optional OWL 3 field widget + Hoot test, PDF report, JSON controller, wizard, website Interaction, Python tests |
| [`odoo_db`](#odoo_db) | asks first | Manage allowlisted Odoo 20 databases with odoo-bin (db init/duplicate/drop, module install/upgrade, neutralize) |
| [`odoo_test`](#odoo_test) | asks first | Install/update modules and run their tests with odoo-bin (--test-tags, --stop-after-init) on a throwaway copy of the template database |
| [`odoo_job`](#odoo_job) | read-only | Status, log tail or cancellation of a background job started by odoo_test / odoo_db / odoo_server |
| [`odoo_server`](#odoo_server) | asks first | Run an Odoo 20 development server on 127.0.0.1 for an allowlisted database (for browsing, the JSON-2 live tool, tours, or browser debugging with the chrome-devtools MCP) |
| [`odoo_shell`](#odoo_shell) | asks first | Execute Python in an Odoo 20 environment (like odoo-bin shell) to inspect real data or behaviour |
| [`odoo_live_call`](#odoo_live_call) | asks first | Call a running Odoo 20 server through the JSON-2 API (POST /json/2/&lt;model&gt;/&lt;method&gt;, Bearer API key) |

## Workspace and lookup (read-only, static index)

### odoo_status

Odoo version, source/addons paths, index state, runtime interpreter, database allowlist, live config. Call first in a session or when other tools say the index is building.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `refresh` | boolean | `false` | Start a background re-index of changed modules |
| `format` | `markdown` \| `json` | `'markdown'` | Output format |

### odoo_search

Find Odoo symbols by (fuzzy, substring) name across all indexed modules: modules, models, fields (model.field), methods (model.method()), XML ids, OWL templates, JS registry entries (category:key), JS modules (@addon/path), JS classes and asset bundles. Returns name, kind, module and file:line.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `query` | string | **required** | Name or fragment, e.g. 'sale.order', 'partner_id', 'view_order_form', 'many2one_avatar', 'useProps' |
| `kind` | `module` \| `model` \| `field` \| `method` \| `xmlid` \| `owl_template` \| `js_registry` \| `js_module` \| `js_class` \| `asset_bundle` | — | Restrict to one symbol kind |
| `module` | string (optional) | — | Restrict to one module |
| `limit` | integer | `30` | Maximum rows |
| `offset` | integer | `0` | Rows to skip (pagination) |
| `format` | `markdown` \| `json` | `'markdown'` | Output format |

### odoo_grep

Full-text search over the Odoo source tree (framework + all addons) and extra addons paths, using git grep. Use for usages, string literals, xmlids in JS/Python, and anything the symbol index does not cover.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `pattern` | string | **required** | Text to find (literal unless regex=true) |
| `regex` | boolean | `false` | Treat pattern as a Perl/Python-style regex |
| `ignore_case` | boolean | `false` |  |
| `module` | string (optional) | — | Search only this module |
| `glob` | string (optional) | — | File name glob, e.g. '*.py', '*.xml', '*.test.js' |
| `context` | integer | `0` | Context lines around matches |
| `limit` | integer | `100` | Maximum rows |
| `include_vendor` | boolean | `false` | Also search i18n/ and static/lib/ |

### odoo_module

Module overview: manifest, depends, dependency/install closure, dependents, load order, files by type, models defined/extended, views, data records, asset bundles, tests, migrations/upgrades/populate dirs.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | **required** | Technical module name, e.g. 'sale_stock' |
| `format` | `markdown` \| `json` | `'markdown'` | Output format |

### odoo_model

Merged view of an Odoo model across modules (static): every contributing class in load order, mixin parents, _inherits delegation, attributes (_order, _rec_name...), all fields with type/comodel/key attributes and which modules define or override them, methods and SQL constraints/indexes. resolve="db": the final fields (fields_get) of the model in an allowlisted database.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `model` | string | **required** | Model name, e.g. 'sale.order' |
| `field` | string (optional) | — | Show one field: merged attributes, every definition/override and views using it |
| `scope_module` | string (optional) | — | Restrict to what is installed together with this module (its dependencies plus auto_install modules). Omit to consider all indexed modules. |
| `include` | string | `'all'` | Comma list of sections: inheritance, fields, methods, constraints, or all |
| `include_tests` | boolean | `false` | Include test_* modules when no scope_module |
| `resolve` | `static` \| `db` | `'static'` | "static" = source index; "db" = ask Odoo itself in an allowlisted database (slower, exact) |
| `db` | string (optional) | — | Allowlisted database for resolve="db" (default: live_db option, else odoo20_tmpl) |
| `limit` | integer | `200` | Maximum rows |
| `offset` | integer | `0` | Rows to skip (pagination) |
| `format` | `markdown` \| `json` | `'markdown'` | Output format |

### odoo_method

Override chain of a model method in call order (last-loaded override first, down to mixins and BaseModel): module, file:line, decorators, signature, and whether each override calls super().

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `model` | string | **required** | Model name |
| `method` | string | **required** | Method name, e.g. 'action_confirm', 'write', '_compute_amount' |
| `scope_module` | string (optional) | — | Restrict to what is installed together with this module (its dependencies plus auto_install modules). Omit to consider all indexed modules. |
| `include_code` | boolean | `false` | Include the source of each override (first 8) |
| `format` | `markdown` \| `json` | `'markdown'` | Output format |

### odoo_xmlid

Where an XML id is defined (model, file:line, key values, noupdate) and every XML/CSV/Python reference to it (ref=, eval ref(), %(xmlid)d, inherit_id, groups, menu parent/action, env.ref, has_group).

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `xmlid` | string | **required** | Fully qualified XML id, e.g. 'sale.view_order_form' |
| `limit` | integer | `100` | Maximum rows |
| `format` | `markdown` \| `json` | `'markdown'` | Output format |

### odoo_views

Backend views and server QWeb templates: inheritance tree (priority, mode, groups, xpath specs, file:line) for an xmlid, or the primary views of a model. resolve="db" (with xmlid) returns the exact combined arch computed by Odoo in an allowlisted database where the modules are installed.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `xmlid` | string (optional) | — | View or QWeb template xmlid: show its inheritance tree, specs and t-call callers |
| `model` | string (optional) | — | List the primary views of this model |
| `view_type` | string (optional) | — | With model: list, form, kanban, search, calendar, graph, pivot, activity, card, hierarchy |
| `resolve` | `static` \| `db` | `'static'` | "static" = source index; "db" = ask Odoo itself in an allowlisted database (slower, exact) |
| `db` | string (optional) | — | Allowlisted database for resolve="db" (default: live_db option, else odoo20_tmpl) |
| `format` | `markdown` \| `json` | `'markdown'` | Output format |

### odoo_access

Odoo 20 access control for a model: every ir.access row (CSV and XML) split into permissions (with a group, OR-ed) and restrictions (no group, AND-ed), with operation, domain, module and location; plus field-level groups.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `model` | string | **required** | Model name |
| `format` | `markdown` \| `json` | `'markdown'` | Output format |

### odoo_js

Odoo web client (OWL 3) lookups from static/src: registry entries, patch() targets, ES module exports and importers, OWL templates and their t-inherit extensions, component classes.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `registry` | string (optional) | — | Registry category (e.g. 'fields', 'views', 'actions', 'services', 'public.interactions', 'web_tour.tours'); '' lists all categories |
| `key` | string (optional) | — | With registry: one key |
| `patches_of` | string (optional) | — | Class whose patch() calls to list, e.g. 'FormController' |
| `module_path` | string (optional) | — | ES module path, e.g. '@web/core/utils/hooks': file, exports, importers |
| `template` | string (optional) | — | OWL template name: definition, t-inherit extensions, components using it |
| `js_class` | string (optional) | — | JS class: definition, subclasses, patches |
| `limit` | integer | `200` | Maximum rows |
| `offset` | integer | `0` | Rows to skip (pagination) |
| `format` | `markdown` \| `json` | `'markdown'` | Output format |

### odoo_assets

Asset bundle composition from all manifests in module load order: append/prepend/before/after/replace/ remove/include directives and globs. resolve="db": the final ordered file list Odoo builds in an allowlisted database (installed modules only).

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `bundle` | string | **required** | Bundle name, e.g. 'web.assets_backend' |
| `scope_module` | string (optional) | — | Restrict to what is installed together with this module (its dependencies plus auto_install modules). Omit to consider all indexed modules. |
| `resolve` | `static` \| `db` | `'static'` | "static" = source index; "db" = ask Odoo itself in an allowlisted database (slower, exact) |
| `db` | string (optional) | — | Allowlisted database for resolve="db" (default: live_db option, else odoo20_tmpl) |
| `limit` | integer | `300` | Maximum rows |
| `offset` | integer | `0` | Rows to skip (pagination) |
| `format` | `markdown` \| `json` | `'markdown'` | Output format |

## Quality

### odoo_validate

Static validation for Odoo 20: legacy (&lt;=19) patterns that break in 20 with the fix and the upgrade_code script that automates it; Odoo's RNG schemas for data files and views; cross-module checks (view fields and buttons exist on the model, missing depends, ir.access rows, xmlids, JS imports, unloaded files); ruff.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | **required** | Module directory, folder of modules, or one file |
| `checks` | string | `'all'` | Comma list: legacy, rng, semantic, lint (default all) |
| `min_severity` | `error` \| `warning` \| `info` | `'info'` | Lowest severity to report |
| `limit` | integer | `200` | Maximum rows |
| `format` | `markdown` \| `json` | `'markdown'` | Output format |

### odoo_upgrade_code

Run Odoo's own upgrade_code scripts (odoo/upgrade_code) on a sandbox copy of your addon and return a unified diff: 19.x -&gt; 20.0 rewrites (t-call params, base64-&gt;bytes, ir.model.access+ir.rule -&gt; ir.access, ormcache, Material Symbols icons, search date filters) plus OWL 2 -&gt; 3. apply=true writes the result. Then run odoo_validate for what the scripts do not cover.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | **required** | Your addon directory (or a folder of addons). Never the Odoo tree. |
| `from_version` | string | `'19.0'` | Version the code was written for |
| `include_owl3` | boolean | `true` | Also run the owl3-migration script when the addon has static/ |
| `script` | string (optional) | — | Run only this script (name fragment, e.g. 'ir-access', 'owl3-migration', 'material-symbols') |
| `apply` | boolean | `false` | Write the changes back (default: dry run returning a diff) |
| `max_diff_lines` | integer | `300` | Diff lines per file |

## Authoring

### odoo_scaffold

Create an Odoo 20 module skeleton that installs and passes its tests as generated: model with models.Constraint, security/ir.access.csv (permission + multi-company restriction), list/form/search views with &lt;chatter/&gt;, action with path, menus, optional OWL 3 field widget + Hoot test, PDF report, JSON controller, wizard, website Interaction, Python tests.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | **required** | Technical module name (snake_case) |
| `dest` | string | **required** | Existing addons folder to create the module in |
| `model` | string (optional) | — | Main model, e.g. 'library.book' |
| `label` | string (optional) | — | Human name, e.g. 'Library Books' |
| `features` | string | `'views,tests'` | Comma list of: views, mail, owl, report, controller, wizard, interaction, tests (default views,tests) |

## Runtime (odoo-bin on allowlisted databases)

### odoo_db

Manage allowlisted Odoo 20 databases with odoo-bin (db init/duplicate/drop, module install/upgrade, neutralize). Databases outside the allowlist are never touched. Long operations return a job id.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | `list` \| `create_template` \| `create` \| `install` \| `upgrade` \| `neutralize` \| `drop` | **required** | list databases; create_template (odoo20_tmpl: base+web); create a DB (copy of the template); install/upgrade modules; neutralize; drop |
| `name` | string (optional) | — | Database (must match the allowlist, default odoo20_*) |
| `modules` | string | `''` | Comma list of modules for create/install/upgrade |
| `with_demo` | boolean | `false` | Load demo data (create_template/create from scratch) |
| `wait` | integer | `120` | Seconds to wait for completion before returning a job id |

### odoo_test

Install/update modules and run their tests with odoo-bin (--test-tags, --stop-after-init) on a throwaway copy of the template database. Returns pass/fail counts and failure tracebacks (or a job id to poll).

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `modules` | string | **required** | Comma list of modules to install and test |
| `test_tags` | string (optional) | — | --test-tags spec (default '/module' for each module), e.g. '/sale:TestSaleOrder.test_x', 'post_install', '-at_install' |
| `db` | string (optional) | — | Existing allowlisted DB to update+test (default: throwaway copy of odoo20_tmpl, dropped afterwards) |
| `keep_db` | boolean | `false` | Keep the throwaway database for inspection |
| `install` | boolean | `false` | With db: install (-i) instead of update (-u) |
| `timeout` | integer | `1800` | Kill the run after N seconds |
| `wait` | integer | `300` | Seconds to wait for completion before returning a job id |
| `js_tests` | boolean | `false` | Also run the modules' Hoot JS unit tests (web WebSuite in headless Chrome; slower) |

### odoo_job

Status, log tail or cancellation of a background job started by odoo_test / odoo_db / odoo_server.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `job_id` | string (optional) | — | Job id (omit to list this session's jobs) |
| `action` | `status` \| `log` \| `cancel` | `'status'` | status, log tail, or cancel |
| `lines` | integer | `120` | Log lines for action=log |
| `grep` | string (optional) | — | Regex filter for action=log, e.g. 'ERROR\|FAIL' |

### odoo_server

Run an Odoo 20 development server on 127.0.0.1 for an allowlisted database (for browsing, the JSON-2 live tool, tours, or browser debugging with the chrome-devtools MCP).

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | `start` \| `stop` \| `status` \| `logs` | `'status'` | Server action |
| `db` | string (optional) | — | Allowlisted database to serve |
| `port` | integer | `8070` |  |
| `dev` | string | `'xml,qweb,access'` | --dev features: access, qweb, xml (reload needs watchdog) |
| `update` | string | `''` | Modules to update (-u) at start |

### odoo_shell

Execute Python in an Odoo 20 environment (like odoo-bin shell) to inspect real data or behaviour. Rolled back unless commit=true and the allow_writes option is on; cr.commit() inside the code is blocked.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `db` | string | **required** | Allowlisted database |
| `code` | string | **required** | Python run with `env` (superuser); print() output and the variable `result` are returned |
| `commit` | boolean | `false` | Commit the transaction (needs allow_writes); default rolls back |
| `timeout` | integer | `180` |  |

## Live server (JSON-2)

### odoo_live_call

Call a running Odoo 20 server through the JSON-2 API (POST /json/2/&lt;model&gt;/&lt;method&gt;, Bearer API key). Read methods (search_read, read, fields_get, read_group, ... or @api.readonly) run freely; anything else needs the allow_writes option.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `model` | string | **required** | Model, e.g. 'res.partner' |
| `method` | string | **required** | Public method, e.g. 'search_read', 'fields_get', 'action_confirm' |
| `ids` | array (optional) | — | Record ids (for record methods) |
| `kwargs` | object (optional) | — | Keyword arguments, e.g. {'domain': [...], 'fields': [...], 'limit': 20} |
| `context` | object (optional) | — | Context, e.g. {'lang': 'en_US'} |
| `timeout` | integer | `60` |  |
